caption:
Your PDF. Your device. Your call.

Meet Plivvi: free, open-source tools for everyday paperwork. Read, merge, sign and organize documents in your browser, with no required account. Document processing runs on your device; optional cloud connections are your choice.

Open it on your phone, tablet or laptop: plivvi.pages.dev

Built by Ramtin Neshatvar. Try one real task and tell me where the app could be better.
carousel_caption:
A document tool should make the small jobs easier.

Plivvi is free, open source and built around processing documents in your browser. Use it as a guest, or add the web app to your device for quicker access.

Save this for the next time you need to merge, read or sign a PDF.
